settings.label: Can I redeem swag for a refund?
settings.text: Swag redemptions are final sale. If an item arrives damaged, contact the care team and we will replace it.

settings.label: Do the first-order savings stack with other codes?
settings.text: Only one discount code works per order, and codes cannot be combined with subscription pricing.

settings.label: How do I get early access to a launch?
settings.text: Join the insiders list with your email or phone number. Each launch has its own sign-up that opens a few days before release.
